title: Rehearsal

lines.text: A city once paid for rats by the tail.
It was a plan that looked sensible on paper, and for a few weeks the numbers were wonderful to read.
Then the people in charge noticed something odd in the streets, and nobody could quite explain it at first.
The hunters had learned what the reward was really paying for, and they gave the city exactly that and no more.
What gets counted gets gamed. That is the idea, and it turns up wherever a number stands in for a goal.
So before you set a target in 1902 or today, ask what the cheapest way to hit it would be, because someone will find it.
